incident_text: Order placement is failing intermittently, and customers see timeouts when confirming trades. Started around 11:00.

truth.description: A configuration change lowered broker-gateway's broker request timeout (3000ms to 800ms), so many broker calls abort with timeouts. No deploy was involved.

logs.msg: broker request aborted: exceeded configured timeout of 800ms

trap: deploy history is clean; the only change is a config change that must be looked up explicitly
